verdict_reason: AlphaEarth (CC-BY 4.0, GEE catalog, global, annual 2017-2024) and CLMS HRL Crop Types (Copernicus free/open incl. commercial, EEA38, annual 2017-2023, 10m/0.25ha MMU) both fetched, open, no application needed. 7 overlapping years support a crop-history baseline. Additionality/BAU/leakage labels are not shipped anywhere; must be constructed as a proxy from the crop-type time series itself.

sources.name: AlphaEarth Foundations Satellite Embedding V1 (Annual)
sources.licence_quote: This dataset is licensed under CC-BY 4.0
sources.coverage_quote: covers terrestrial land surfaces and shallow waters, including intertidal and reef zones, inland waterways, and coastal waterways
caveats_quoted: temporal trajectories of surface conditions ... over a single calendar year

sources.name: Copernicus Land Monitoring Service High Resolution Layer Crop Types 2017-present
sources.licence_quote: can be used following Copernicus full free and open data policy, which allows the use of the product(s) also for any commercial purpose
sources.coverage_quote: covers 5.751 million square kilometers across the EEA-38 region
sources.date_range: Annual data from 2017 through 2023, with reference years for validation including 2018, 2021, and 2022
caveats_quoted: many crop types fall below the 80% target, particularly "dry pulses, fresh vegetables & potatoes" and permanent crops

sources.name: EuroCrops (harmonized EU LPIS crop-declaration parcels)
sources.coverage_quote: 17 European Union countries (Austria, Belgium, Czechia, Germany, Denmark, Estonia, Spain, France...)
sources.date_range: varies by country, e.g. 2018-2021; latest release v11 via Zenodo
caveats_quoted: quote from fetched page summary, not raw HTML; country/year list should be re-confirmed at Zenodo record before use

ground_truth.construction_protocol: Proxy labels from CLMS/EuroCrops multi-year crop-type series: BAU = cover crop present in prior years; additional = first appearance in claim year; leakage-risk = neighboring parcel converted cropland-to-bare/other same period. No verified additionality ground truth exists externally.
ground_truth.label_count_estimate: Millions of EU parcels have crop-type history (CLMS/EuroCrops scale); zero have curated additionality/leakage labels

compute_path.platform: Google Earth Engine (AlphaEarth GEE catalog) + WEkEO/direct download for CLMS COG tiles
compute_path.why: AlphaEarth embeddings are precomputed (no training); CLMS is tile-based download; a shallow classifier on embeddings runs on free CPU, no sustained GPU needed

notes: land.copernicus.eu product page returned HTTP 401; CLMS details instead verified via the fetchable PUM technical-library page and EEA sdi catalogue metadata record, both describing the same HRL Crop Types 2017-present dataset. AlphaEarth and CLMS overlap for 7 years (2017-2023), enough for a real crop-history baseline; AlphaEarth itself remains annual-only, no sub-annual resolution.
